```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Create a data frame
data <- data.frame(
  Year = c(1980:2021),
  Freight = c(26825.20036, 28360.5003, 29046.29979, 32407.89991, 36841.9996,
              37061.70017, 40331.80009, 45392.70014, 50418.59999, 54428.20029,
              56124.90035, 56142.30008, 61025.19974, 67522.60019, 77183.30033,
              83098.2004, 89164.59998, 102876.1012, 101788.2743, 108629.6182,
              118257.211, 110860.835, 117506.673, 124203.199, 139032.94,
              141483.603, 148937.604, 158205.946, 158487.874, 175509.3437,
              182498.6271, 183532.2301, 175567.3422, 176421.5578, 185517.1095,
              188363.4163, 195588.2751, 213628.6472, 222156.7008, 219524.4478,
              182526.1849, 219227.3285)
)

# Create the plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = Year, y = Freight)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Hava taşımacılığı, yük (milyon ton-km)",
       x = "Yıl",
       y = "Yük (Milyon Ton-Km)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Bölgelere Göre
```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Create data frame
data <- data.frame(
  Region = c("Afrika", "Asya Pasifik", "Avrupa", "Latin Amerika", "Ortadoğu", "Kuzey Amerika", "Toplam"),
  CTK = c(17.0, 24.6, 16.4, 13.4, 25.9, 9.3, 18.4),
  RPK = c(18.1, 31.8, 10.0, 9.9, 16.2, 6.0, 16.6)
)

# Reshape data for ggplot2
data_melted <- melt(data, id.vars = "Region")

# Create bar plot
ggplot(data_melted, aes(x = Region, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Bölge", 
       y = "Büyüme Oranı (%)",
       fill = "Ölçüm") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTK" = "steelblue", "RPK" = "firebrick"))



```


```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Create data frame
data <- data.frame(
  Airport = c("Hong Kong (HKG)", "Memphis (MEM)", "Şangay (PVG)", "Anchorage (ANC)", "Incheon (ICN)", 
              "Louisville (SDF)", "Miami (MIA)", "Doha (DOH)", "Los Angeles (LAX)", "Taipei (TPE)"),
  Cargo_Tonnes = c(4331976, 3881211, 3440084, 3380374, 2744136, 2727820, 2525591, 2355503, 2130835, 2112988)
)

# Sort data by cargo volume
data <- data[order(data$Cargo_Tonnes),]

# Create horizontal bar chart
ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(Airport, Cargo_Tonnes), y = Cargo_Tonnes)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip the axes for better readability
  labs(title = "2023 Yılında En Yoğun 10 Kargo Havalimanı",
       x = "Havalimanı",
       y = "Kargo (Metrik Ton)") +
  theme_minimal()

```


# Harita olarak
```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(ggrepel)

# Create data frame with airport locations
data <- data.frame(
  Havalimanı = c("Hong Kong (HKG)", "Memphis (MEM)", "Şangay (PVG)", "Anchorage (ANC)", "Incheon (ICN)", 
              "Louisville (SDF)", "Miami (MIA)", "Doha (DOH)", "Los Angeles (LAX)", "Taipei (TPE)"),
  Kargo_Ton = c(4331976, 3881211, 3440084, 3380374, 2744136, 2727820, 2525591, 2355503, 2130835, 2112988),
  Longitude = c(113.9185, -89.9767, 121.8083, -149.9981, 126.4505, -85.7365, -80.2906, 51.6138, -118.4085, 121.232),
  Latitude = c(22.3080, 35.0425, 31.1434, 61.1744, 37.4691, 38.1744, 25.7959, 25.2731, 33.9416, 25.0777)
)

# Get world map data
world_map <- map_data("world")

# Create map visualization
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "lightgray", color = "white") +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Kargo_Ton), color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(data = data, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Havalimanı), size = 3, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Boylam", y = "Enlem") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Örnek veri:
data <- data.frame(
  stance = rep(c("Supporter", "Opponent"), each = 4),
  semantic_category = rep(c("Animal", "Both", "Human", "None"), 2),
  percentage = c(24.9, 18.3, 18.6, 38.2,   # Supporters
                 50.6, 12.2, 3.0, 34.2)     # Opponents
)

# Renk paleti: Care/Harm teması için uygun soft renkler
ggplot(data, aes(x = semantic_category, y = percentage, fill = stance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percentage, "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#d95f02","#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Semantic Inversion in Care/Harm Foundation",
    subtitle = "Human-centric vs. Animal-centric moral referents by stance",
    x = "Semantic Category",
    y = "Percentage of Care/Harm Mentions",
    fill = "Stance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )


```

```{r}

# Gerekli paketler
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Veri: Source ve Target aktörleri
actor_data <- data.frame(
  Actor = c("Media", "Business", "NGO", "Academy", "Politician"),
  Source = c(3876, 2016, 1844, 1526, 304),
  Target = c(1683, 3779, 1203, 1607, 1294)
)

# Uzun formata dönüştür (ggplot için)
actor_long <- actor_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Source, Target), 
               names_to = "Type", 
               values_to = "Tweets")

# Yüzdelik hesaplama (isteğe bağlı)
actor_long <- actor_long %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Tweets / sum(Tweets) * 100)

# Görselleştirme
ggplot(actor_long, aes(x = reorder(Actor, -Tweets), y = Percent, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percent)), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00")) +
  labs(
    title = "Actor Distribution in Sustainability Discourse (2012–2023)",
    subtitle = "Media leads as source; Business dominates as target",
    x = "Actor Type",
    y = "Percentage of Tweets",
    fill = "Actor Role"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r}

# Gerekli paketler
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================
# 1. VERİ
# ============================================
data <- data.frame(
  Subcategory = c("Environmental_Resources", "Economic_Growth", "Governance_Reporting", 
                  "Policy_International", "Environmental_Climate", "Policy_National",
                  "Social_Community", "Governance_Corporate", "Environmental_Energy",
                  "Innovation_Technology", "Social_Equity", "Innovation_RnD",
                  "Economic_Investment", "Social_Labor", "Governance_Integrity"),
  Category = c("Environmental", "Economic", "Governance",
               "Policy", "Environmental", "Policy",
               "Social", "Governance", "Environmental",
               "Innovation", "Social", "Innovation",
               "Economic", "Social", "Governance"),
  Count = c(857, 735, 729, 692, 597, 505, 439, 437, 338, 206, 103, 73, 55, 52, 6)
)

# ============================================
# 2. GÖRSELLEŞTİRME
# ============================================
# Alt kategoriyi count'a göre sırala
data <- data %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  mutate(Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = Subcategory))

ggplot(data, aes(x = Subcategory, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
```

```{r}

# Gerekli paketler
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(stringr)

# 1) Dosyayı yükle
path <- "/Users/kemalgunay/Desktop/VERI_BILIMI/SUSTAINABILITY-TOPIC/TM/df_analyzed.csv"
df <- readr::read_csv(path, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))

# 2) Tema sütunu adını otomatik tespit et (olası varyantlar)
possible_theme_cols <- c("Deteched_Themes", "Detected_Themes", "DetectedThemes", "themes", "Themes")
theme_col <- intersect(possible_theme_cols, names(df)) %>% first()

if (is.na(theme_col)) {
  stop("Tema sütunu bulunamadı. Mevcut sütunlar: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "),
       "\nLütfen tema sütunu adını kontrol edin veya yukarıdaki olası adlardan birine yeniden adlandırın.")
}

# 3) Temaları temizle ve explode et
df_clean <- df %>%
  rename(THEME_RAW = !!sym(theme_col)) %>%      # standart isim ver
  mutate(THEME_RAW = if_else(is.na(THEME_RAW), "", as.character(THEME_RAW))) %>%
  mutate(
    THEME_RAW = str_replace_all(THEME_RAW, "\\[|\\]", ""),    # köşeli parantezleri kaldır
    THEME_RAW = str_replace_all(THEME_RAW, "\\'|\\\"", "")   # varsa tırnakları temizle
  ) %>%
  mutate(THEME_LIST = str_split(THEME_RAW, ",\\s*")) %>%     # ayır
  unnest(THEME_LIST) %>%
  mutate(THEME = str_trim(THEME_LIST)) %>%
  select(-THEME_RAW, -THEME_LIST)

# 4) Eğer bazı satırlarda boş tema varsa çıkar (opsiyonel)
df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(THEME != "" & !is.na(THEME))

# 5) Frekans ve yüzde hesapla (her aktör için)
#    Burada "SOURCE_TYPE" kullanılıyor; istersen "TARGET_TYPE" ile aynısını yapabilirsin.
actor_col <- "SOURCE_TYPE"
if (!actor_col %in% names(df_clean)) stop(paste0(actor_col, " sütunu bulunamadı."))

theme_freq <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(!!sym(actor_col), THEME) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(!!sym(actor_col)) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_by_actor = sum(Freq),
    Percent = Freq / Total_by_actor * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(!!sym(actor_col), desc(Percent))

# 6) Her aktör için top5 al ve 'Other' ekle ki toplam %100 olsun
top_n <- 5

theme_top5_with_other <- theme_freq %>%
  group_by(!!sym(actor_col)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  mutate(is_top = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # top5'leri al
  bind_rows(
    # diğerlerini toplayıp 'Other' satırı ekle
    theme_freq %>%
      group_by(!!sym(actor_col)) %>%
      slice(-(1:top_n)) %>%               # top5 dışındakiler
      summarise(Freq = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(theme_freq %>% select(!!sym(actor_col), Total_by_actor) %>% distinct(),
                by = actor_col) %>%
      mutate(
        THEME = "Other",
        Percent = if_else(Total_by_actor > 0, Freq / Total_by_actor * 100, 0)
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(actor_col), THEME, Freq, Total_by_actor, Percent)
  ) %>%
  group_by(!!sym(actor_col)) %>%
  # sıralama: önce top temalar (mevcut sıralama korunur), sonra Other
  arrange(!!sym(actor_col), desc(Percent)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 7) Görselleştirme: Aktörler x ekseni, yüzdelik stacked bar (top5 + Other)
plot <- theme_top5_with_other %>%
  mutate(ACTOR = !!sym(actor_col)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ACTOR, y = Percent, fill = THEME)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Percent >= 5, sprintf("%.1f%%", Percent), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Aktör Başına Top 5 Tema (% olarak) + Other",
    x = "Aktör (SOURCE_TYPE)",
    y = "Yüzdelik Pay (%)",
    fill = "Tema"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(plot)

# 8) Dilersen dosyaya kaydet
ggsave("/Users/kemalgunay/Desktop/VERI_BILIMI/SUSTAINABILITY-TOPIC/TM/top5_themes_by_actor_percent.png",
       plot = plot, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)


```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# 1. Veriyi oku
df <- read_csv("/Users/kemalgunay/Desktop/VERI_BILIMI/SUSTAINABILITY-TOPIC/TM/df_analyzed.csv")

# 2. Temaları temizle ve ayır
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Deteched_Themes = str_replace_all(Deteched_Themes, "\\[|\\]", ""),
    Deteched_Themes = str_replace_all(Deteched_Themes, "\\'|\\\"", "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Deteched_Themes = str_split(Deteched_Themes, ",\\s*")) %>%
  unnest(Deteched_Themes) %>%
  mutate(Deteched_Themes = str_trim(Deteched_Themes)) %>%
  filter(Deteched_Themes != "")

# 3. Her aktör-tema çifti için yüzde hesapla
theme_percent <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(SOURCE_TYPE, Deteched_Themes) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Percent = Freq / Total * 100)

# 4. En çok geçen 5 temayı bul (tüm aktörlerde toplam)
top_themes <- theme_percent %>%
  group_by(Deteched_Themes) %>%
  summarise(TotalFreq = sum(Freq)) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalFreq)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(Deteched_Themes)

# 5. Sadece top 5 temayı al
theme_top5 <- theme_percent %>%
  filter(Deteched_Themes %in% top_themes)

# 6. Görselleştirme
ggplot(theme_top5, aes(x = Deteched_Themes, y = Percent, fill = SOURCE_TYPE)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percent)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Aktörlerin En Çok Kullandığı 5 Tema (%)",
    x = "Tema",
    y = "Yüzde (%)",
    fill = "Aktör"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

# 1. Load data
df <- read_csv("/Users/kemalgunay/Desktop/VERI_BILIMI/SUSTAINABILITY-TOPIC/TM/df_analyzed.csv")

# 2. Clean and separate themes
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Deteched_Themes = str_replace_all(Deteched_Themes, "\\[|\\]", ""),
    Deteched_Themes = str_replace_all(Deteched_Themes, "\\'|\\\"", "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Deteched_Themes = str_split(Deteched_Themes, ",\\s*")) %>%
  unnest(Deteched_Themes) %>%
  mutate(Deteched_Themes = str_trim(Deteched_Themes)) %>%
  filter(Deteched_Themes != "")

# 3. Count frequency of each theme per year
theme_trends <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(CREATED_YEAS, Deteched_Themes) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(TotalPerYear = sum(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Percent = Freq / TotalPerYear * 100)

# 4. Select top N themes overall (for readability)
top_themes <- theme_trends %>%
  group_by(Deteched_Themes) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Freq)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 6) %>%
  pull(Deteched_Themes)

theme_trends_top <- theme_trends %>%
  filter(Deteched_Themes %in% top_themes)

# 5. Plot temporal evolution
ggplot(theme_trends_top, aes(x = CREATED_YEAS, y = Percent, color = Deteched_Themes, group = Deteched_Themes)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2013, 2023, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Evolution of Top Sustainability Themes (2013–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share of Mentions (%)",
    color = "Theme"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```
